## Phase: 52 - Heuristic Evolution — Counter Scoring, Deprecation Lifecycle, Dashboard

### SCHEMA.md counter and status fields
from: [[wiki:heuristic-schema]]
retrieved: 2026-05-27

- YAML frontmatter defines helpful: 0, harmful: 0 (integer counters) and status enum: active | deprecated | under-review | iron. No transition rules exist yet — this phase adds them.
- All 15 heuristic articles currently have counters at 0. This phase activates the feedback loop.
- Heuristic article format requires 6 sections + YAML frontmatter with id, trigger, domain, source_phase, confidence, helpful, harmful, status.

### Fire-and-forget and counter isolation
from: [[decision:fire-and-forget-heuristic-judge]]
retrieved: 2026-05-27

- Judge output is never shown to the planner — counter updates are a pure side-effect of the judge verdict, not a feedback path.
- Counters must NOT influence matcher selection (Phase 48: per-rule selection not viable due to stochastic interference). Counters are retrospective analytics only.
- IRON RULES (status: iron) accumulate counters for observability but never transition — status is immutable.

### Uniform global verdict attribution
from: [[decision:counter-attribution-uniform-global-verdict]]
retrieved: 2026-05-27

- Single judge verdict applies uniformly to all matched heuristics (up to 3). Known approximation — per-heuristic attribution would require judge prompt changes.
- helpful += 1 on judge score >= 6/10. harmful += 1 on judge score <= 4/10 AND reviewer score >= 6/10. No update at score = 5.

### SKILL.md companion file pattern
from: [[decision:dev-plan-scope-extraction]]
retrieved: 2026-05-27

- SKILL.md at 316/350 lines. New features require companion files with 2-3 line Read pointers in SKILL.md.
- Companion files require YAML frontmatter: parent + referenced_at fields.
